headline: Tuesday, November 10 — sunny peak, Granite paperwork day

sections.lead: Six application emails landed overnight. One is the big one:
items: GRANITE: 'Offer Documents Waiting for you' + 'Action Required' (Mon afternoon/evening) — your Dispatcher II offer paperwork is live in Workday Candidate Home, under My Tasks
Sign-in: granite.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/careers — review and sign today; HR Help is HRHelp@gcinc.com if anything blocks
Rejections (old EA/ops lane, all moot now): Golden State Warriors Director T&A, Rivian Staff Business Systems Analyst, Ambience Healthcare Chief of Staff, HPE Labs Strategy & Ops Program Specialist
Sunny all day, the warmest of the week: high 75, low 50, 0% rain, light wind (sunrise 6:42, sunset 4:59)
Hour by hour: 5am 56, 8am 60, 10am 66, noon 72, 2pm 74, 3pm 75 (peak), 5pm 71, 8pm 63, 10pm 62, clear tonight
Week: Wed (Veterans Day) sunny 68/50, Thu partly sunny 65/50, Fri RAIN 75% 61/50 with gusts to 29 mph, Sat partly sunny 64/50, Sun rain 75% 61/51, Mon light rain 55% 58/46
Friday's storm grew overnight: more rain and stronger gusts than yesterday's read
The mood lifts today: the Moon moved into Sagittarius after yesterday's deep Scorpio reset, so the heaviness eases and a lighter, forward-looking energy takes over
The Moon now sits easy with your natal Venus: warmth flows in conversation, so today is good for the people-facing bits (the Granite paperwork, a thank-you, checking in on someone)
One caveat: Mercury is still retrograde across from your Sun, which astrologers read as easy-to-miss details — so read every page of the offer docs slowly before you sign
How to use it: do the paperwork first while the energy is bright, then let the day stay easy

(Waxing crescent, Moon Sagittarius 5.0°; Moon trine natal Venus orb 2.1°; Neptune Aries 2.2° trine natal Venus orb 0.6°; Pluto Leo 27.9° sextile natal Moon orb 1.0°; Mercury retro Scorpio 6.9° square natal Sun orb 2.2°; Saturn retro Aries 11.7° trine natal Sun orb 2.6°)

The Job Hunt tab still carries the old tech/EA-lane leads; say the word and I'll clear the non-construction ones off it

Reminder: Antioch's Holiday Food & Toy Giveaway is Sunday, Nov 22
Sign the Granite offer documents: Workday Candidate Home, My Tasks (10-15 minutes, read slowly — Mercury retro)
Routine: 10am apply run, 3pm construction-dispatch sweep, 5pm site check, 7pm apply run
Your calendar is clear all day, no appointments — yesterday's POM call and IOP group are done
Tony's calendar is quiet today
Warmest day of the week today, two more dry days, then a bigger storm Friday and again Sunday
